summary: iter-135 (Help Center, Onboarding, Support, Status, Legal) — full e2e verified. 12/12 backend HTTP tests pass (public status, legal, tickets lifecycle, IDOR, admin queue, onboarding pending/skip/persist, auto-done for user with accounts). Frontend: public /status renders all 6 components with data-testids, /privacy & /risk-disclosure render markdown, sidebar carries all new nav-* testids incl. nav-admin-support for admin, Help Center hub/legal links/16 article cards/search filter ('refund'→2, category 'billing'→3)/article open+back all work, Onboarding wizard shows for a fresh registered user, risk quiz persists (risk_level=high applied), step persists across reload (broker step held), SKIP hides it and stays hidden after reload (status=skipped), Admin · Support Queue filters render with counts (OPEN·0 · ANSWERED·0 · CLOSED·1) and the admin API returns the expected shape.

integration_issues.issue: In one browser session on /support the new-ticket form did not render within 6s after clicking support-new-ticket-btn. Could not reproduce cleanly in a second run because admin already had closed tickets. HTTP path (POST /api/support/tickets) is fully verified end-to-end; UI likely fine but flagging so main agent can retry a clean session.

action_items: None blocking. Optional: sanity-check that clicking support-new-ticket-btn always opens the NewTicketForm even when the ticket list is still loading (tickets===null); currently the button is rendered only when !creating && !active — if that condition ever races with a slow GET /support/tickets the header action might be missing. HTTP flows all pass, so this is UI-only nit.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_routes.public_status caches globally in _STATUS_CACHE (30s) — acceptable for a public status page; note the test relies on order-of-execution via _STATUS_CACHE reset.

support_routes.reply: is_admin computed as `user.role=='admin' AND ticket.user_id != user.id` — this means if an ADMIN opens their own ticket, replies go in as 'user' (verified: STOIC SUPPORT styling only applies when a different admin replies). This is intentional and correct.

OnboardingWizard uses fixed inset-0 z-[80] backdrop-blur — it fully overlays app content while pending. It is properly hidden once status !== 'pending', so it will not block a returning admin who has skipped/completed. Good.

portal_routes.onboarding_state auto-flips to 'done' when db.accounts count > 0 for a user — admin@stoicaibot.com had no accounts docs in preview and therefore did see the wizard (matches context_note). If desired, admins could be exempted by role but not required.
AdminSupport imports TicketThread and STATUS_PILL from Support.jsx — good re-use, no duplication.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend HTTP suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iter135_portal_http.py — run `pytest tests/test_iter135_portal_http.py` from /app/backend. Uses CSRF double-submit (login sets csrf_token cookie, we mirror into X-CSRF-Token header). Fresh user wizard flow requires resetting `db.users.$unset:{onboarding:''}` if you re-run the same email. If admin doesn't have any db.accounts docs the wizard will show on login for admin too — this is by design; call POST /api/onboarding {status:'done'} or click SKIP to dismiss. Public routes (/api/status, /api/legal/*) require no auth and no CSRF.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. The one intermittent UI observation for the support form is timing-related (heavy initial page hydration with rate-limited /api/onboarding retries logged as 401s during logged-out screenshots); HTTP layer is definitively correct.
